description: Java class implementing a Clojure-based service engine for Apache OFBiz, enabling execution of services written in Clojure within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: StandardClojureEngine
classes.description: A service engine class that allows executing Clojure services within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: callClojure
methods.description: Loads a Clojure namespace and calls a specified function with the provided dispatch context and input parameters.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously, ignoring the return value.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously and returns the result as a Map.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Internal method that prepares context and invokes the Clojure service, handling exceptions.
